text:
Deleting your account (under "Account" > "Privacy") takes up to 30 days and cancels your subscriptions, including Plant Club, so you won't need to cancel it separately.

One thing to know: if a Plant Club box has already been billed, it isn't refunded on cancellation and is still sent. Boxes are charged on the 25th of the previous month, so if you're on or past the 25th, the next box is likely already billed. If you'd rather stop future charges right away, you can also cancel from "Account" > "Subscriptions" first, with no cancellation fee.

Would you like help with anything else before you delete?
